2123233656240275523.en_summary: First Squawk: BOJ Governor Ueda says the BOJ's smaller footprint in the JGB market is giving long-term interest rates greater scope to reflect market views on economic prospects, prices and policy.
2123233656240275523.zh_summary: First Squawk：日本央行總裁植田和男表示，日本央行在日本國債市場的足跡縮小，讓長期利率有更大空間反映市場對經濟前景、價格與政策的看法。

2123233321081807053.en_summary: First Squawk: BOJ Governor Ueda says currency movements could exert stronger inflationary pressure than in the past, shaping both underlying prices and long-term inflation expectations.
2123233321081807053.zh_summary: First Squawk：日本央行總裁植田和男表示，匯率變動可能較過去施加更強通脹壓力，影響基礎價格與長期通脹預期。

2123233148343607474.en_summary: First Squawk: BOJ Governor Ueda admits it is difficult to assess the BOJ's response to a combination of weak domestic demand and a falling yen.
2123233148343607474.zh_summary: First Squawk：日本央行總裁植田和男承認，評估日本央行對國內需求疲弱與日圓下跌組合的回應相當困難。

2123231709739049344.en_summary: Danielle DiMartino Booth posts ICYMI quoting @darioperkins on the scariest thing from 2000 analysis: Fed took comfort from shortages, bottlenecks and order backlogs in tech six months after bubble burst, and Greenspan's comments on high-tech executives' net worth.
2123231709739049344.zh_summary: Danielle DiMartino Booth 發文 ICYMI，引述 @darioperkins 分析 2000 年最可怕之處：泡沫破裂六個月後聯準會仍從科技短缺、瓶頸與訂單積壓中感到安慰，以及葛林斯潘對高科技主管淨值的評論。

2123231676214255944.en_summary: James E. Thorne criticizes FOMC minutes agreeing on December hike, only timing disagreement; calls hiking before falling oil/gas prices and data a joke. Criticizes Governor Waller pre-committing to 50bp jumbo hike on CNBC before data, undercutting Chair Warsh. Notes services inflation above 2% in 94.6% of months since 1968, only recession will change it. Quotes Bloomberg on minutes showing possible more than 25bp if inflation unfavorable.
2123231676214255944.zh_summary: James E. Thorne 批評 FOMC 會議紀錄已同意 12 月加息，僅時點有爭議；稱在油價氣價下跌與數據出爐前加息是笑話。批評 Waller 總裁在數據前於 CNBC 預先承諾 50 個基點大幅加息，削弱 Warsh 主席。指出自 1968 年以來 94.6% 的月份服務通脹高於 2%，只有衰退才能改變。引述彭博關於會議紀錄顯示若通脹不利可能超過 25 個基點。
